output_json.diff_review: Non-POV diff touches 4 files. IoUtil.java adds CALLBACK_PATTERN and validateCallback(String), which throws IllegalArgumentException for non-null callbacks not matching a plain/dotted JS identifier, and calls it at the top of streamResponseAndClose (the sink on the POV path, shared by servlet and JVM-agent streaming). AgentServlet.sendAllJSON and JolokiaHttpHandler.sendAllJSON add the same validation to their non-streaming fallback paths. IoUtilTest.java adds two legitimate regression tests (malicious callback rejected with zero bytes written; dotted callback still produces the JSONP wrapper). The change is targeted at the vulnerable sink, blocks angle brackets, quotes, parens and whitespace, and does not remove vulnerable functionality without justification since legitimate JSONP still works. The exception message intentionally omits the offending value, preventing reflection via error pages. git status confirms only these 4 files plus the untracked .security-pipeline/ POV dir changed — no unrelated behavior added.
output_json.pov_result: Reran the POV via the Docker wrapper on the patched worktree: exit 1, output "[pov] NOT REPRODUCED: malicious callback was not reflected as a JSONP wrapper (patched)". The servlet flow now raises InvocationTargetException (IllegalArgumentException from validateCallback) and the response body is empty. The orchestrator before-patch log shows exit 0 "VULNERABLE" with the payload reflected verbatim, confirming the POV genuinely detects the vulnerability and the patch neutralizes it. The POV diff adds only .security-pipeline/ files, so the fix is exercised against an unmodified exploit.
output_json.regression_result: Both regression suites pass on patched code, reproduced independently via the Docker wrapper: IoUtilTest 5/5 (Failures 0, Errors 0) and AgentServletTest 22/22 (Failures 0, Errors 0). The new IoUtilTest cases confirm both that malicious callbacks are rejected with zero bytes written and that legitimate dotted callbacks still yield the correct JSONP wrapper, so the fix does not regress valid functionality.
output_json.summary: The patch fixes the JSONP callback reflected XSS (CWE-079) with a strict JS-identifier allowlist validator invoked at all three JSONP sinks before any bytes are written. It is minimal, does not modify or disable the POV, preserves legitimate (optionally dotted) callbacks, and does not echo the callback in error messages. Independently reran the POV (exit 1, NOT REPRODUCED) and both regression suites (IoUtilTest 5/5, AgentServletTest 22/22) — all pass.
